clinical_course: Admitted with 4 days cough, fever, SOB. CXR R lower lobe consolidation. SpO2 91% RA on arrival, O2 via NP x48h. IV ceftriaxone + oral azithro, stepped down to PO on day 3. BSL labile on admission, insulin sliding scale, now back on home metformin. Afebrile >48h, SpO2 96% RA, ambulant.
follow_up: GP review in 5-7 days. Repeat chest X-ray in 6 weeks. Check blood sugar at home twice daily and bring the log.
warning_signs: Breathlessness at rest, chest pain, lips turning blue, fever returning after 2 days, confusion, blood sugar above 300 or below 70.
activity_and_diet: Rest, increase activity gradually. Drink plenty of fluids. Continue diabetic diet.

medications.name: amoxicillin-clavulanate
medications.frequency: three times a day after food

medications.name: paracetamol
medications.frequency: every 6 hours as needed for fever
